notes.title: Update 1.1
notes.content:
Update 1.1 Patch Notes

* Title logo design update
* Added language support: Simplified Chinese, Traditional Chinese, Japanese
* Various bug fixes and some level design adjustments

notes.title: [Notice] Frog Escape has been released!!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45311316/4de14fab88b3244e64dec5f9ee12286df17bfd43.png[/img]

[b]Frog Escape[/b] has been released!
Let the cute frog girl escape with your abilities!

[b][A discount on release][/b]
You can play it first with a week-long 10% discount.


[b][Will be updated later][/b]
We are planning to support a total of two languages.
- Japanese language
- Chinese

If you have any bug reports or inquiries, please report them to the email below.
teamesc0630@gmail.com

Thank you.
Team Escape
